title: Luscious Mexican Pozole
description: A hearty, comforting Mexican stew made with tender pork, hominy, and a blend of spices. Serve with a squeeze of lime and a sprinkle of feta for a flavorful treat.
instructions: Brown the pork shoulder in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the cumin and chili powder to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pozole to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks and return it to the pot.
Stir in the feta cheese and lime juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional feta cheese and lime wedges if desired.
